tool_config.name: create_booking
tool_config.description: Books the chosen time. Only after you have read back the caller's name, the service, the date and the time, and the caller clearly said yes. For a paid service this sends a payment link and holds the time for 15 minutes.

Authorization.secret_id: <SECRET_ID: Hourhand tool key for this host>

language.description: The language the caller is speaking: en or hi.

start.description: The slot's `start` value exactly as get_free_slots returned it.

name.description: The caller's full name, as they confirmed it.

email.description: The caller's email address, spelled back and confirmed. Empty if they have none.

phone.description: A different number to reach them on, with country code. Empty to use the number they are calling from.

whatsapp_ok.description: True only if the caller said yes to getting the confirmation on WhatsApp.

confirmed_with_caller.description: True only after the read-back and a clear yes from the caller.
